userStories.title: Verdict calculation core
userStories.description: Pure calculation from plain item facts to a verdict: disenchant table, material pricing, Disenchant Value net of the auction cut, three verdicts with a margin, no-price outcome, who-can-act rule.
acceptanceCriteria: Every band's chances add up to 1, bands do not overlap, every drop is a known material
Disenchant Value is the probability-weighted average of the drops at the given prices, minus 5%
A lesser essence is valued at the lower of its own price and a third of the greater essence
Verdict is disenchant, vendor or close call according to the margin; the margin is adjustable
A missing price for a drop of at least 1% gives no price; a rarer drop is ignored
Items that cannot be disenchanted, and kept items, get no verdict
Non-enchanters get a verdict only for unbound items while the enchanter-alt setting is on
Tests run outside the game and pass

userStories.title: Verdict line on item tooltips
userStories.description: The addon loads on WoW Forever and adds one coloured verdict line with Vendor Value and Disenchant Value to the tooltip of any disenchantable item.
acceptanceCriteria: The addon appears in the Forever addon list and loads without Lua errors
Hovering an uncommon, rare or epic weapon or armor piece shows a verdict line with both values
The line is green for disenchant, a neutral colour for vendor, yellow for close call
Items that cannot be disenchanted show no line
With a material price missing, the line reads no price data
Without Auctionator loaded, the addon still loads and shows no errors
A soulbound item on a non-enchanter shows no line
The translation from game values to plain item facts is tested outside the game where it is pure

userStories.title: Material breakdown and price age
userStories.description: Holding Shift lists the materials with odds and quantity ranges in the game's language; the scan price age is shown; the breakdown works without Auctionator.
acceptanceCriteria: Holding Shift adds one line per drop: chance, quantity range, material name
Material names follow the game's language, with an English fallback until the name is cached
The oldest price age among the drops is shown when it is more than a day
Without Auctionator the materials are listed and no verdict is claimed
The text of the breakdown lines is produced by a pure function with tests

userStories.title: Settings: margin and enchanter alt
userStories.description: Account-wide saved settings for the close-call margin and the enchanter-alt switch, changeable by slash command and in the game's settings panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings are created with defaults on first load and survive a reload and a relog
A slash command shows the current settings and changes the margin and the switch
The settings panel has a DustOrGold category with a margin slider and the switch
Switching the enchanter-alt setting off removes verdicts on a non-enchanter
Applying defaults to stored settings is a pure function with tests

userStories.title: Keep list
userStories.description: Items the player marks get no verdict anywhere; added and removed by slash command with an item link, saved account-wide.
acceptanceCriteria: An item can be added to and removed from the keep list with a slash command and an item link
A kept item shows no verdict line on its tooltip
The keep list survives a reload and a relog
A command lists the kept items
The keep list (add, remove, contains, parsing an item ID from a link) is pure and tested

userStories.title: Bag list window
userStories.description: A window listing every bag item with a verdict, grouped into vendor, disenchant, close call and no price data, with totals. Advice only, no sell button.
acceptanceCriteria: The slash command toggles the window
Each row shows the item, its Vendor Value and its Disenchant Value
Groups appear in a fixed order with a total
Items with no price data are listed in their own group
Kept items and items without a verdict do not appear
The window updates after selling or disenchanting an item
Grouping, totals and sorting come from a pure Bag Report module with tests

userStories.title: Disenchant button in list
userStories.description: For enchanters, each disenchant and close-call row has a secure button that casts Disenchant on that bag item, out of combat only.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a row's button disenchants that exact bag item
Buttons are absent on a character that cannot disenchant
Entering combat hides or disables the buttons without Lua errors or taint warnings
After a disenchant the row disappears and the buttons point at the right slots

userStories.title: Results log capture
userStories.description: Every disenchant the player performs is recorded account-wide with the item's facts and the materials received.
acceptanceCriteria: Disenchanting an item adds exactly one record with the item's facts and the materials received
Loot from anything other than a disenchant adds no record
Records survive a reload, a relog and an addon update
Building a record from item facts and received materials is a pure function with tests

userStories.title: Compare results with table
userStories.description: A slash command compares recorded disenchant results with the table per band and calls out results the table says are impossible.
acceptanceCriteria: The command prints one summary per band that has records
A received material the table does not list for that band is called out
Records whose item level and required level fall in different bands are reported with which one matched the result
The comparison is a pure function over a list of records, with tests

userStories.title: Verify client assumptions in game
userStories.description: HITL: an in-game session confirming Disenchant detection, bound detection, item level, Auctionator prices and the events that fire on a disenchant, using a debug slash command.
acceptanceCriteria: On an enchanter, the addon detects that the character can disenchant; the working signal is recorded
On a non-enchanter, it detects that the character cannot
Soulbound and bind-on-pickup items are seen as bound; a bind-on-equip item is not
An item marked as not disenchantable is detected from its tooltip line
The item level the addon reads matches the auction house
Auctionator returns a price for a scanned dust
The events that fire on a disenchant are noted

userStories.title: Own auction prices
userStories.description: Collect our own auction prices (material searches on auction house open, every full scan read, /dog scan) and use them before Auctionator's.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the auction house updates material prices and says how many were found
Tooltips and the list use our own price when we have one, Auctionator's otherwise
A full scan started by Auctionator fills our prices too, gear included
/dog scan runs a full scan when 15 minutes have passed, and says how long to wait otherwise
Our material searches do not break Auctionator's or the auction house's own searches
The price logic (batch price, item keys, storage, own-first choice) is pure and tested
